content:
Connor O'Brien: starting an enablement thread for internal beta of safe apply + rollback (optimization config versioning). want to lock a checklist + owners so we’re not scrambling on the day we flip the flag.

Connor O'Brien: proposal: internal beta enablement = (1) on-call ready, (2) dashboards + gates wired, (3) support ready, (4) release train sequencing confirmed. dropping strawman checklist below.

Connor O'Brien: 
Release sequencing / dependencies
- [ ] Control plane: Optimization Config Service deployed (CRUD + version list/diff + apply/rollback endpoints)
- [ ] Runtime: idempotent config applier + rollback checkpoints shipped to canary workers
- [ ] Console: history + diff + rollback button behind feature flag
- [ ] RBAC policy bundle updated (optimization change operator)
- [ ] Audit log schemas live + SIEM export not breaking
- [ ] Observability pack dashboard panels + annotations deployed
- [ ] Feature flag(s): `opt_cfg_safe_apply_enabled`, `opt_cfg_console_rollback_enabled` (names tbd) with rollout plan

On-call / ops readiness
- [ ] Runbook: rollback-optimization-config is final + linked from Console + incident-bot
- [ ] Gameday: 1 dry-run before beta (simulate p95 regression, rollback, verify recovery)
- [ ] Paging: who gets paged for gate failures? SRE vs platform? (need explicit)
- [ ] Cooldowns: confirm rollback cooldown behavior + how to override during Sev

Dashboards / gating
- [ ] Rollout Health dashboard has required tags (tenant/model/region/config_version)
- [ ] Gate rules configured w/ sane defaults (5xx, p95, p99) + false positive playbook
- [ ] Quantization quality gate wired to eval harness for beta accounts (or explicitly off)

Support enablement
- [ ] Support FAQ: how to identify active config version, where to see audit events, how to escalate
- [ ] Comms: internal beta announcement + “what to do if you see regressions”

Owners: please comment w/ what you can take, and any missing items.

Talia Benson: +1. also need a clear “beta account list” + who approves additions. we got burned last time when it leaked to 3 more tenants via shared infra.

Paula Mendes: for beta list: propose internal-only + 2 friendly external accounts (already asked) but internal beta should be Redwood tenants first. i’ll draft list + criteria (traffic profile + ability to tolerate rollback tests).

Chloe Martin: Console side: history + diff + rollback modal are ready-ish behind `opt_cfg_console_rollback_enabled`. missing: final copy for “blast radius summary” + the type-to-confirm string. Kenji had notes but not in prod yet.

Connor O'Brien: ty. can we make the type-to-confirm string deterministic? e.g. `ROLLBACK <version_id>`? don’t want “type tenant name” since tenant may have spaces.

Chloe Martin: yep, we can do `ROLLBACK <scope>` and `<scope>` is rendered exactly (tenant/model/region). i’ll add a ticket to lock this by end of week.

Sean Gallagher: on-call readiness: runbook is close but i want explicit “decision criteria” section (when to rollback vs pause canary). also, who is authorized to click rollback during Sev-1? right now RBAC is too strict in staging.

Marcus Lin: re: RBAC — the policy bundle change introduces `optimization_change_operator` + allows rollback for scoped tenants. but we should *not* allow global rollback to everyone in on-call rotation by default.

Sean Gallagher: agreed, but in Sev-1 we can’t wait for policy edits. can we have an emergency break-glass role? (audited)

Marcus Lin: break-glass can be `security_incident_operator` with time-bound elevation + mandatory reason string. if we do that, audit logging must include `elevation_request_id` + `reason`. i can sync w/ Kevin Osei.

Connor O'Brien: adding to checklist: break-glass + audit fields + process doc.

Allison Grant: dashboards/gates: we’re missing config_version tag in 2 of the latency panels (p99 is okay, p95 isn’t). i’ll patch in observability-pack today. for gate defaults: proposed thresholds for beta
- error rate: +0.3% absolute over baseline for 10m
- p95: +15% over baseline for 10m
- p99: +20% over baseline for 10m
with “pause rollout” on breach, not auto-rollback.

Sahana Iyer: CI/e2e: we have validate→canary→promote→rollback e2e in staging but it flakes when perf-canary job runs in parallel (resource contention). i can stabilize but need a dedicated staging window or we’ll keep seeing noise.

Connor O'Brien: can we schedule an off-hours staging window? otherwise release train will block.

Talia Benson: i can reserve staging Tue 7–9pm PT for load tests + e2e. will send calendar.

incident-bot: Reminder: When enabling new feature flags for production-like tenants, link the runbook and add #eng-oncall FYI. Use `/incident shortcuts` to attach relevant URLs.

Paula Mendes: support enablement: Support asked last week how to see “active config version” without console access. do we have headers yet? (openai-compat?)

Connor O'Brien: I saw a PR to optionally surface config version in response headers. not sure if it’ll land before beta.

Allison Grant: we can also expose it in logs/traces. but for Support, best is Console view + a read-only internal endpoint.

Chloe Martin: Console history view shows “Active version” + last applied + who. we can add a copyable “version id” and a link to audit event detail. i’ll make sure that’s in beta.

Marcus Lin: please ensure audit payloads include request_id + actor + scope + prior_version + target_version. we had an enterprise escalation where rollback event was missing (don’t want repeat).

Connor O'Brien: noted. for beta, minimum audit events we must see in SIEM export:
- optimization_config.version_created
- optimization_config.validated
- optimization_config.apply_started / apply_paused / apply_completed
- optimization_config.rollback_started / rollback_completed
- optimization_config.promoted (if we use promotion semantics)

Sean Gallagher: also want rollback to annotate dashboards. if we don’t have annotations, on-call will miss correlation.

Allison Grant: yep, dashboard annotations are driven off the audit stream -> metrics annotation job. once rollback_completed emits, we annotate w/ config_version and scope.

Sahana Iyer: question: do we require perf-canary gate job for internal beta? it’s heavy.

Paula Mendes: for internal beta i’d prefer yes for Hosted (we’ll learn). for Dedicated we can start w/ SLO gates only. quant quality gate can be opt-in.

Connor O'Brien: ok, beta policy proposal:
- Hosted internal tenants: SLO gates ON + perf-canary ON
- Dedicated beta: SLO gates ON, perf-canary optional
- Quant quality gate: OFF by default, ON only for 1–2 test models w/ Jonas/Arjun signoff

Sean Gallagher: +1. also need a documented rollback verification checklist (after click):
1) active version flipped in Console
2) p95 recovers within 10–15m
3) error rate normal
4) workers converge (no mixed versions) — how do we check convergence?

Chloe Martin: Console will show rollout status per shard: “Applying / Converged / Stalled”. but runtime also emits `config_apply_state` metric by worker w/ version tag.

Allison Grant: we have a panel “workers by config_version” for convergence. i’ll make sure it’s on the rollout dashboard.

Connor O'Brien: action items (please react w/ :thumbsup: if ok)
- Connor: publish release train sequencing doc + feature flag plan, incl required SHAs
- Talia: staging reservation + beta tenant list process
- Paula: draft beta account list + support FAQ outline
- Chloe: finalize rollback modal copy + type-to-confirm string; ensure history view exposes active version clearly
- Sean: update rollback runbook w/ decision criteria + verification checklist; propose paging ownership
- Allison: patch dashboard tag gaps + add convergence panel; propose final gate thresholds
- Marcus: RBAC break-glass proposal + audit field requirements; coordinate security signoff
- Sahana: stabilize e2e in staging (flake reduction) + report go/no-go by Wed

Talia Benson: :thumbsup: will send staging hold + draft beta list criteria today.

Paula Mendes: :thumbsup: will share beta list + support notes in #support-leads by EOD tomorrow.

Chloe Martin: :thumbsup: will land modal copy change behind flag and post screenshots.

Sean Gallagher: :thumbsup: i’ll update runbook + ping #eng-oncall for review once ready.

Allison Grant: :thumbsup: dashboard patch in flight. will post link when merged.

Marcus Lin: :thumbsup: will draft break-glass + audit requirements and loop in Aisha Rahman for signoff.

Sahana Iyer: :thumbsup: will run e2e during Tue staging window and report results.

Connor O'Brien: great. next check-in Thu. please keep updates in this thread so we have one place to reference during enablement.
